question:
Select the one-word term for:

**"A brief note or explanation added alongside a diagram or passage to provide clarity or context."**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Annotation)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Annotation"** refers to a brief note or explanation added alongside a diagram, text, or passage to provide clarity or context. (टिप्पणी)

 
 
• **Example:** The professor added annotations to the research paper to explain technical terms for the students.
 
 
 
• Annotations are often used in books, articles, or diagrams to help readers understand specific points or terms better. (टिप्पणियाँ)
 
 
• **Example:** The annotated map included details about historical landmarks for tourists.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1 (Annotation)**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Annotation)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Footnote** (पादटिप्पणी): A note placed at the bottom of a page to provide additional information or references.

 
 
• **Example:** The author included a footnote to cite the source of the statistics mentioned in the article.
 
 
 
• **Glossary** (शब्दकोष): A list of terms and their definitions, usually found at the end of a book or document.
 
 
• **Example:** The glossary in the textbook helped students understand technical jargon.
 
 
 
• **Caption** (कैप्शन): A short description or title accompanying an image or illustration.
 
 
• **Example:** The caption under the photograph explained where it was taken.
